purpose: Complete backend placement map: all 112 nodes, 231 base directions, 22 additional corrected directions and 58 structured RouteRule v2 records.

operatingPrinciple.registry: All 112 Track IDs exist before content is built.
operatingPrinciple.designGraph: All 231 directions are imported as known connections and future next-action slots.
operatingPrinciple.correctedGraph: 22 RouteRule directions absent from the base graph are added, producing 253 effective track-to-track directions.
operatingPrinciple.routeEngine: The 58 RouteRule v2 records provide structured automatic/conditional routing where available.
operatingPrinciple.installation: When a Track ID receives content, Cursor reads connectionIndex[id] and attaches all known incoming/outgoing connections without editing neighboring pages.
operatingPrinciple.access: Connections may exist in backend while user-facing content and buttons remain locked until publication, entitlement and route policy allow them.

rulesOfUse: The effectiveTrackConnections array is authoritative for complete track-to-track placement and direction.
The base 231 design connections remain visible for provenance; 22 corrected/new RouteRule directions are layered on top.
A design connection without a structured rule is not discarded; it becomes a locked next-action slot.
A user-facing automatic transition requires an allowed RouteRule status, published destination content and entitlement.
A design-only connection may later be exposed as an explicit user choice after its label and condition are approved.
No page may hardcode neighboring URLs; all destinations come from this graph and the Route Engine.
Installing content for one Track ID must not require editing any neighboring track page.
